sentence: This project extends an analysis platform to handle large single-cell data sets better and link regulatory activities to bases in the genome.
This project uses molecular dynamics simulations to study how mutations in voltage-gated sodium channels change their structural dynamics at the atomic level.
This project tries to find out how titin gene expression is regulated and how to raise titin levels to treat dilated cardiomyopathy.
This project studies how an oncovirus replicates and persists in daughter cells in the hypoxic environment of cancers linked to it.
This project studies the role of neural circuits in behavioral impairments caused by chronic social stress in male and female mice.
This project studies the genetics of cannabis use disorder and how genetic risk changes the effects of cannabinoids in human laboratory studies.
This project makes recombinant antibodies against two inhibitory receptors, including one bispecific antibody that binds both.
This project builds an electronic tool that gives clinicians a searchable data stream and alarms to improve care for babies born with difficult health conditions.
This project studies what controls a lung stem cell in the smallest airways and how it is altered in chronic obstructive lung disease.
This project studies how metastatic melanoma develops in the liver and why it resists immunotherapies.
This project tests how peripheral nerve stimulation relieves chronic neuropathic pain and what predicts who responds to it.
This project studies how tissue architecture and forces control gene expression in dental stem cells of the mouse incisor.
This project studies how drugs change the behavior of zebrafish larvae to find treatments for substance use disorders.
This project tries to find out how Chlamydia fuses its inclusions together and how this affects its ability to cause disease.
This project builds a small system that grows lymph node tissue together with other organs and lets white blood cells move between them.
This project tries to find out why Black patients with acute myeloid leukemia and mutated nucleophosmin have unfavorable outcomes.
This project uses deep learning and single-cell data to find autoreactive B cell receptors in patients with seronegative Myasthenia Gravis.
This project studies how genetics, developmental stage and immune challenges shape the immune system of children, using very small blood samples.
This project uses smartphone data, cognitive testing and recordings from clinical visits to predict outcomes for young psychiatric patients.
This project uses mouse models to test whether deleting a melanocortin peptide weakens the response to metabolic challenges.
